title: Replace VALVE, CONTROL, GLOBE WITH DIAPHRAGM ACTUATOR 4" P300 (4"-P300-P-1005/B13)
notice: DEMONSTRATION ONLY — NOT A QUALIFIED PROCEDURE; THE FACILITY OWNER'S QUALIFIED PROCEDURES AND APPLICABLE CODES GOVERN.
reason: Control valve trim worn; replace the valve in kind.
scope: Isolate per the isolation list, drain and vent 4"-P300-P-1005 between the isolations.
Unbolt and remove VALVE, CONTROL, GLOBE WITH DIAPHRAGM ACTUATOR 4" P300 (4"-P300-P-1005/B13) at E 33'-6"  N -15'-7-15/16"  EL 121'-0".
Inspect both flange faces (SW-NDE-5); dress or report damage.
Install a new VALVE, CONTROL, GLOBE WITH DIAPHRAGM ACTUATOR 4" P300 of the same size, class and face-to-face (CONTROL4-P300), with new gaskets and studs, stem orientation as removed.
Tighten the studs to the stated preload in three passes, cross pattern (SW-WO-5).
Remove blinds, restore the line-up, leak test the two joints on start-up (SW-TEST-2).

isolations.description: Close and lock VALVE, GATE, WEDGE, OS&Y 4" P300 (4"-P300-P-1005/B16)
Fit a line blind between 4"-P300-P-1005/B16 and VALVE, CONTROL, GLOBE WITH DIAPHRAGM ACTUATOR 4" P300 (4"-P300-P-1005/B13), work side
Close and lock VALVE, GATE, WEDGE, OS&Y 4" P300 (4"-P300-P-1005/B10)
Fit a line blind between 4"-P300-P-1005/B10 and VALVE, CONTROL, GLOBE WITH DIAPHRAGM ACTUATOR 4" P300 (4"-P300-P-1005/B13), work side

inspections.description: Flange faces of both joints before the new gaskets go in
inspections.criteria: No radial scratch across the sealing face (SW-NDE-5)

test.description: Both remade joints checked at operating pressure on start-up

parts.description: VALVE, CONTROL, GLOBE WITH DIAPHRAGM ACTUATOR 4" P300
STUD SET 4 × 1" × 6-1/4" WITH 2 NUTS, FOR 4" P300
STUD SET 4 × 1" × 6-1/4" WITH 2 NUTS, FOR 4" P300
